About Founders
Yogesh Mishrra
Founder | Indian Films Academy

Yogesh Mishrra is an Indian filmmaker, actor, director, and one of the most trusted cinematic acting mentors
in India. Trained under theatre maestro Shri Surya Mohan Kulshreshtha and shaped within the classical theatre 
environment of Bharatendu Natya Academy and National School of Drama, he blends classical performance 
depth with modern cinematic craft.
       
After completing engineering, Yogesh Mishrra professionally trained in Cinematic Acting, Direction, Editing, 
DI Color Grading, and VFX. He has directed Dabang Sarkar and Vidyapeeth, and has served as a
post-production head on 15+ feature films. With 15+ years of experience in acting training, he founded 
Indian Films Academy seven years ago and is the creator of the Actors Transformation System (ATS). 
Having trained 100+ students, he is known for transforming performers into true cinematic artists.

Dinesh Kumar Sahgal
Co-Founder | Indian Films Academy

With over 30 years of distinguished experience across the Government, Film, Media & Entertainment 
sectors, Mr. Dinesh Kumar Sahgal has played a pivotal role in shaping film policy, media infrastructure,
and talent development in Uttar Pradesh. As Deputy Director, Information & Public Relation 
Department / Film Bandhu, Government of Uttar Pradesh, he has been instrumental in promoting
UP as a Film-Friendly State on national and international platforms.

An academician, administrator, and visionary media professional, he holds an M.Sc. (Mathematics), 
B.Ed., and a Post-Graduate Diploma in Computer Science, along with advanced training in 
Multimedia & Theatre. His contributions extend to major film festivals, digital governance projects,
actor training, and cultural initiatives.Through Indian Films Academy, he continues to guide and 
empower aspiring actors with institutional strength, industry access, and ethical professionalism.
